phases.title: Fix favouriteController: stop inline 404 response, call next(err) instead
phases.notes: Removed inline res.status(404).json() branch for ProductNotFoundError in add(); now calls next(err) unconditionally. Also removed unused ProductNotFoundError import. Build and tests pass (remaining failure is compare controller, handled in phase-2).

phases.title: Fix compareController: pass error argument to next(err) instead of next()
phases.notes: Changed catch (_err) { next() } to catch (err) { next(err) } so the error propagates to the error handler. All 22 tests pass, build clean.

phases.title: Fix rateLimiter: throw RateLimitError instead of plain Error so errorHandler sets Retry-After header
phases.notes: Imported RateLimitError from '../errors' and replaced next(new Error(...)) with next(new RateLimitError(retryAfter)). All 22 tests pass, build clean.

phases.title: Run tests and verify all success criteria pass
phases.notes: All 22 tests pass across 2 test files. Build (tsc) exits cleanly with no errors. All three prior fixes (favouriteController next(err), compareController next(err), rateLimiter RateLimitError) are verified working.
